backdrop.bias: soft: testing the $80.5K-81K floor under the ETF cost basis; Fed and BOJ next week
backdrop.commentary: Evening (6:20 PM CT, Oct 23): BTC ~$80.85K (-0.5% 24h; 24h $80.55K-$81.94K) slipped into the evening after a tight Friday: CryptoWatchDesk had it ending the US session near $81.2K, with $81K, Thursday's $80.81K low and $80K as the floors and $81.95K, $82.7K-82.85K and $84.25K above. It sits under the ~$82.3K average cost basis of US spot ETF buyers (Glassnode via CoinDesk) after the $635M Oct 22 outflow. Macro is still the driver: the Dow fell 1.2% after Thursday's AI-led tech rout, and Brent topped $116, a six-month high, after attacks in Saudi Arabia, and the 10-year yield is near 5% (CoinDesk, CryptoWatchDesk). US October PMIs stayed firm (manufacturing 56.0, services 57.9) and the Fed is ~90% priced to hold on Oct 28 (FXStreet). Signals: 1h/4h Sell under the 4h EMAs (~$81.9K-82.2K); 1d Sell, under the EMA20 (~$82.4K) and right on the EMA50 (~$80.8K). Fear & Greed 46 (neutral), OKX funding ~0.01%, total market cap ~$2.71T (-3.5% 24h). Yen: USD/JPY ~156.8 (Yahoo; day 156.07-157.16), its best week since early September on safe-haven buying (CNBC); 155 hasn't broken and the BOJ is expected to hold on Oct 30, so carry-unwind risk is elevated, not acute. That argues for modest leverage on longs. Policy: the OCC's final GENIUS Act stablecoin rule is in the Federal Register (effective Jan 18, 2027), and the CFTC opened an advance notice on a federal framework for leveraged retail crypto trading (Morgan Lewis). T009 still waits at $79.9K-80.4K.

Japan's September national CPI (core forecast 2.1% after 1.7%) lands a week before the BOJ's Oct 29-30 meeting; a strong print firms December hike bets and the yen.

ripple.bias: bearish: lost the 1.30 floor late Friday; 1.26 Oct low next
ripple.commentary: Evening (6:20 PM CT, Oct 23): XRP ~$1.29 (-1.2% 24h; 24h $1.28-$1.33) slipped under the $1.30 floor it defended all day. FXStreet and CoinEdition put the next supports at $1.26 (the Oct low ~$1.259) and $1.246-1.256, with a daily close under $1.30 opening lower targets; recovery needs a close back above $1.34 and then $1.36-1.37. CoinEdition also flags whale deposits to Binance at a seven-month high, a sign of supply heading to exchanges. Signals: 1h Sell (RSI ~32, below the lower Bollinger band, so stretched), 4h Sell under the 4h EMAs (~$1.319-1.328), 1d Strong Sell under the daily EMAs (~$1.358-1.369). Adoption news from the day still stands: Ripple and Arf plan RLUSD settlement liquidity on the XRPL, and Singapore's BLOOM stablecoin initiative, which includes Ripple, added Malaysia's and Thailand's central banks. The OCC's final GENIUS Act stablecoin rule (effective Jan 18, 2027) was published today. T011 still waits for a rally into $1.355-1.37; the move came without that rally, so it stays pending rather than chasing.

stellar.commentary: Evening (6:20 PM CT, Oct 23): XLM ~$0.1726 (-1.3% 24h; 24h $0.1708-$0.1787) is back on its 30-day low area (~0.172) after briefly trading under it. Signals: 1h Neutral (RSI ~27, oversold), 4h Sell under the 4h EMAs (~$0.1777-0.1808), 1d Strong Sell under the daily EMAs (~$0.188-0.192). Adoption news keeps building even as the price lags: Stellar completed its first regulated Treasury-backed repo (Ascend Markets and M1X Global, USDM1 collateral and USDC, 72 hourly rollovers for under one cent in fees), RWA.xyz puts Stellar's tokenized assets at ~$3.64B (36Crypto), and U.S. Bank ran a live USBDC stablecoin pilot on the network (TokenPost). Stellar's Meridian conference is Oct 28-29, the same week as the Fed and BOJ. A long needs a reclaim of ~0.1777-0.1807; a daily close under 0.1708 opens 0.168, then ~0.162.
